metadata.description: cc-arcade: small games inside Claude Code

plugins.name: cc-arcade
plugins.description: Games above the Claude Code prompt (snake, Tetris, Doom, 2048, Minesweeper, Flappy, Pong, typing test, Space Invaders) that pause when Claude finishes a turn, and a pet that grows as Claude tests, commits and edits. Clones of the genre, not affiliated with or endorsed by Tetris Holding, Taito, Atari or id Software
